title: Rental Desk Card: Days Authorized on an Accepted Larger-Class Partner Rental under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement
content:
**Authorized days.** Under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, an accepted larger-class partner rental is authorized for the option's initial authorization days, never fewer than one day. The claim concerned is the physical damage claim the rental is taken on.

## When the day maximum of the loss is applied

The days are fixed when the rental is recorded on the customer's acceptance. The day maximum of the loss is applied when the rental is extended, not when it is recorded. Days already used on the claim therefore do not shorten the days recorded on acceptance.

## Input, judgement and result

| Input | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| The option's initial authorization days | Is the figure fewer than one day? | If not, the authorized days equal that figure. A figure below one would be raised to one day. |
| Days already used on the claim | Applied at the time of recording? | No. They are applied when the rental is extended. |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical inputs)

Take an option whose initial authorization days are 7.

- A customer accepts a larger-class car on a claim where no rental days have yet been used. The rental is recorded with 7 authorized days.
- On a claim where 26 of the 30 maximum days per loss are already used, a larger-class car is accepted. The rental is still recorded with 7 authorized days, because the day maximum of the loss is applied when the rental is extended.
